name: opencode
notes: Requires a prepared opencode/ source tree (v1 line) and Bun in the execution environment. The source is declared in `runtime_paths` rather than copied into the candidate: the monorepo is 174 MB and 3,586 packages, and every `state_after_round<N>/` would carry a copy of it. Each candidate must own its workspace links. External source override is for explicit interface diagnostics only; it is refused by default. Container runtime still requires platform-specific provisioning.
